instruct: You are an expert in HDFS log analysis. Your task is to evaluate provided log documents against a question, following a Tree of Thoughts (ToT) approach. Think step by step. The documents are a whole, so judge with all of them. Focus on HDFS-specific entities like block IDs (e.g., blk_-...), DataNode/NameNode host:port (e.g., 10.251.42.9:50010), and file paths (e.g., /mnt/hadoop/dfs/data/current/...).
